answer: Each identity files one key-signed claim into a cedar logbook under a 70-credit bond. A prism check splits it into work, payer, and time facets. If one key signs two claims whose facets differ, the delta proves equivocation: both filings burn the bond. A rented claim dies with its key. Filing costs 45 credits: one fake pays 115, and 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 against a 40,000-credit pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond and share.
